From e2f4b3be1d3c73176db734565b160250cc1300dd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2021 19:09:44 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] MIPS: boot/compressed/: add __bswapdi2() to target for ZSTD
 decompression

For MIPS pre-boot, when CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD=y, the decompressor
function uses __bswapdi2(), so this object file should be added to
the target object file.

Fixes these build errors:

mips-linux-ld: arch/mips/boot/compressed/decompress.o: in function `xxh64':
decompress.c:(.text+0x8be0): undefined reference to `__bswapdi2'
mips-linux-ld: decompress.c:(.text+0x8c78): undefined reference to `__bswapdi2'
mips-linux-ld: decompress.c:(.text+0x8d04): undefined reference to `__bswapdi2'
mips-linux-ld: arch/mips/boot/compressed/decompress.o:decompress.c:(.text+0xa010): more undefined references to `__bswapdi2' follow

Fixes: 0652035a5794 ("asm-generic: unaligned: remove byteshift helpers")
Fixes: cddc40f5617e ("mips: always link byteswap helpers into decompressor")
Signed-off-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Cc: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Cc: Thomas Bogendoerfer <tsbogend@alpha.franken.de>
Cc: linux-mips@vger.kernel.org
Acked-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Bogendoerfer <tsbogend@alpha.franken.de>

diff --git a/arch/mips/boot/compressed/Makefile b/arch/mips/boot/compressed/Makefile
index 3548b3b45269..9112bdb86be4 100644
--- a/arch/mips/boot/compressed/Makefile
+++ b/arch/mips/boot/compressed/Makefile
@@ -56,6 +56,8 @@ $(obj)/uart-ath79.c: $(srctree)/arch/mips/ath79/early_printk.c
 
 vmlinuzobjs-$(CONFIG_KERNEL_XZ) += $(obj)/ashldi3.o
 
+vmlinuzobjs-$(CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD) += $(obj)/bswapdi.o
+
 extra-y += ashldi3.c
 $(obj)/ashldi3.c: $(obj)/%.c: $(srctree)/lib/%.c FORCE
 	$(call if_changed,shipped)
@@ -64,6 +66,10 @@ extra-y += bswapsi.c
 $(obj)/bswapsi.c: $(obj)/%.c: $(srctree)/arch/mips/lib/%.c FORCE
 	$(call if_changed,shipped)
 
+extra-y += bswapdi.c
+$(obj)/bswapdi.c: $(obj)/%.c: $(srctree)/arch/mips/lib/%.c FORCE
+	$(call if_changed,shipped)
+
 targets := $(notdir $(vmlinuzobjs-y))
 
 targets += vmlinux.bin
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/mips/boot/compressed/Makefile`**
   - Added the line `vmlinuzobjs-$(CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD) += $(obj)/bswapdi.o` to include the `bswapdi.o` object file when the `CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD` configuration option is enabled.
   - Added the line `extra-y += bswapdi.c` to include `bswapdi.c` in the build process.
   - Added a rule to compile `bswapdi.c` from its source location: `$(obj)/bswapdi.c: $(obj)/%.c: $(srctree)/arch/mips/lib/%.c FORCE`, which ensures that the file is built from the specified source directory.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `Makefile` establish a relationship between the configuration option `CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD` and the inclusion of the `bswapdi` helper functions necessary for ZSTD decompression in the MIPS pre-boot environment. By adding `bswapdi.o` to the target object files and ensuring that `bswapdi.c` is compiled from its source, the patch resolves the undefined reference errors related to `__bswapdi2()` that were encountered during the build process. This change directly addresses the build errors reported, ensuring that the necessary byteswap helper functions are available when the ZSTD decompressor is used.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of the `__bswapdi2()` function, which is required by the ZSTD decompressor in the MIPS pre-boot environment when `CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD` is enabled. This function was not linked into the build, leading to undefined reference errors during the compilation process.

Here is the patch:

+vmlinuzobjs-$(CONFIG_KERNEL_ZSTD) += $(obj)/bswapdi.o
+
 extra-y += ashldi3.c

 	$(call if_changed,shipped)
 
+extra-y += bswapdi.c
+$(obj)/bswapdi.c: $(obj)/%.c: $(srctree)/arch/mips/lib/%.c FORCE
+	$(call if_changed,shipped)
+
 targets := $(notdir $(vmlinuzobjs-y))
